NORTHBEAM CLOUD | INTERNAL BRAND BOOK
INTERNAL BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Brand voice, writing style, terminology, claims, visual identity and accessibility
OUR BRAND
A practical guide to how Northbeam Cloud communicates and presents itself.

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Brand Voice
Northbeam Cloud speaks in a professional, plain voice. In B2B channels, keep the language direct:
avoid slang and exclamation-mark hype.
How the voice should sound
• Use clear, plain wording rather than slang.
• Keep B2B copy professional and avoid exclamation-mark hype.
• Speak to the customer as “you”. In marketing copy, avoid referring to the audience as “users”.
• Lead with the customer benefit: files in step across devices. Then introduce the feature.
VOICE EXAMPLE
“It keeps your files in step.”

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Writing Style
Write so the customer benefit is easy to understand before the reader reaches the feature detail.
Writing principles
• Put the benefit first: files in step across devices. Follow with the feature that supports it.
• Address the reader as “you”; use “your team” where a team reference is needed.
• Keep B2B language professional and plain.
• Avoid slang and exclamation-mark hype.
• Check every number in public copy against an approved fact before publication.
Examples
USE AVOID
“It keeps your files in step.” “Insane deal!!!”
“your team” “our users”

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Terminology
Use the preferred product names consistently. Replace banned shorthand or generic wording with the
approved term.
Preferred terms
PREFERRED TERM
Northbeam Sync
Northbeam Vault
Banned wording and replacements
DO NOT USE USE INSTEAD
NB Sync Northbeam Sync
cloud drive Northbeam Vault
Internal terms
The following terms are internal and are not public-facing terminology: Project Atlas and Acme
Retail.

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Claims and Legal Language
Public claims must match the approved facts. Do not turn a feature or service level into a broader
promise.
Claim rules
• Every number in public copy (uptime, customers, savings, speed) must match an approved fact.
• Do not describe service levels as guaranteed; refer to the SLA.
• Do not call Northbeam the best, #1 or market leader unless an approved fact supports it.
• Do not claim legal compliance (GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA). Describe the security feature instead.
Approved public facts
• Northbeam Sync is used by teams in 14 countries.
• Northbeam Sync SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime.
• Files are encrypted at rest with AES-256.
• Northbeam Vault starts at INR 599 per month.
For service-level wording, use “backed by our SLA”. For security wording, use “data encrypted at rest with AES-256”.

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Visual Identity
Use only the brand palette and the Inter typeface. Inter is used for all text.
Brand colours
COLOUR HEX VALUE
Northbeam Navy #1B2A4A
Signal Teal #14B8A6
Cloud White #F8FAFC
Ink Grey #334155
Typeface
Inter — use for all text.
Logo rules
• Keep clear space around the logo on all sides. Do not place other elements within this space.
• Respect the logo’s minimum size. Do not reduce it to a size where its details are no longer clear and
legible.
• Use the primary logo on Cloud White or Northbeam Navy only.
• Never stretch or recolour the logo.

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Accessibility
Make visual content accessible by providing text alternatives and sufficient contrast.
Requirements
• Every image needs alt text.
• Text on images needs 4.5:1 contrast.
• Large text on images needs 3:1 contrast.
IMAGE TEXT MINIMUM CONTRAST
Standard text 4.5:1
Large text 3:1

NORTHBEAM CLOUD BRAND BOOK
Northbeam Cloud
Contact
For brand guidance and questions about applying these standards, contact the Marketing team.
BRAND CONTACT
brand@northbeam.example
